Dialogs.Dialog: (Oh no, I'm late！ The girls' practice match was definitely today...)
Oh, it's ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s match！
Hey, how's the match going？
Member Ａ
Isn't it obvious？ Takane will win for sure.
For sure？
She's the girls' top player, you know？ Plus she's a total beauty, and her grades are always top of the class.
And her family's doctors, so she's a real rich girl...
Huh, really... I bet she's popular.
Rather than popular... It's more like we live in separate worlds. I mean, you know？
What do you mean？
Takane's a bit stiff. Like, the way she talks. She gives off an aura of "Don't get close to me！"
...Is that so？
Captain
Game set！ Count 3-0. Match won by Takane！
Good work！
Takane
▲主人公＊▲.
That was amazing, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！ A total blowout, huh？
Um... thank you. But it was just luck.
No way that was luck！ You were amazing！
Um... I'm going now.
Okay, sorry...
(She doesn't look much like someone who just won...)
(Club activities are over. Guess I'll go home.)
Member
Hey, you're coming too, right？ To Winning Burger.
Winning Burger？ Is there something going on？
We hang out there after practice sometimes. ...The girls come too, you know？
All right, let's go. ...Oh, it's ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Takane
I'll head out first...
Huh？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is going home？
Oh, don't worry about her.
Why not？ Everyone's going, right？ Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
What is it, ▲主人公＊▲？
Everyone's going to Winning Burger. ▲高嶺＊＊▲, want to come？
...I think I'll pass. Have fun with everyone.
See？ We live in different worlds. Let's go！
(...Is that right？)
(Practice is over！ Well, I'll head home... Ah！)
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Takane
▲主人公＊▲.
Heading home？ Let's go together.
Um, together？
Yeah... No good？
(This is kind of awkward...)
Can I ask you a question？
...Eh？ Ah, yes.
How come you always head straight home after practice, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
It's fine if you don't want to answer that.
...Is it strange to go straight home after club activities are over？
Well, it's not strange... I guess.
According to school rules, we're supposed to return home immediately after leaving school, right？
School rules？ Huh... But nobody actually follows that stuff！
Eh？
Well, this is where I turn off.
If you want, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, let's walk home together again？
Um, but I can't stop anywhere on the way...
We'll just go straight home. That way, you won't be violating the school rules, right？
Is that... how it works？ Um, goodbye.
See you later！
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ didn't say no, right？)
(Huh... Isn't that ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
(She seems worried about people seeing her... Hard to call out to her...)
(In and out of that store three times... What's ▲高嶺＊＊▲ doing？)
(Then again, what am I doing... All right！)
Hey！ ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Takane
▲主人公＊▲.
Well...
No, this isn't what it looks like！
Isn't what... what？
Eh？ I mean, you see... Well...
Let's stop by Winning Burger. I'll treat you for helping me before.
But, stopping on the way home...
Then we'll eat promptly. And go home promptly. Okay？
Hehe... Okay, then. Just for a bit.
Clerk
Welcome to Winning Burger！ What would you like to order？
Takane
▲Takane＊＊▲？
Yes！
Aren't you going to order？
Order？ Ah, yeah. Um, I'd like a hamburger, please.
Just the Winning Burger by itself？
Umm... Yes...
Would you like Winning Nuggets and a medium Winning Shake with that？ Right now there's a scratch card for double points！
Um, I... Sorry, could you repeat that from the beginning？
(Don't tell me... ▲高嶺＊＊▲ has never been to a fast food place？)
Okay！ We'll have 2 value meals, and... What would you like to drink？
Um, a drink... tea...
Then iced tea and a cola...
I'll repeat your order. Two value meals and for drinks...
You don't come to places like this much, huh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
That's not true. I come sometimes？
Hmm... Then have you eaten the Mega Teriyaki Noodle Burger？
Mega...？
Last month's special burger.
Of course...
Oh！ I missed out on it. Was it good？ What did it taste like？
Well, it was... not too sweet, not too bitter, and, um, mega...
That doesn't tell me much
...Did you really try it？
So it was good？
Well... it's like noodles with teriyaki, but it's not really like that...
That's a pretty iffy description...
Because it was an iffy kind of flavor...
...Why？
Well, it looks like you're just pretending to know...
I ate it.
Yes, it was very delicious.
You have unusual taste, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Everyone who ate it said it was iffy.
(Am I being a bit mean to her？)
It was delicious. Hehe！
Good for you.
But it has way too much fat and salt. With half the fries, milk to drink, and maybe a tomato, it'd be more balanced.
(She was thinking about that while she ate...？)
See you, then？
Yeah... Um, maybe next time...
Never mind. Thanks for today. Goodbye.
Tezuka
Okay, gather round！
The moment you've all been waiting for！ The tennis club's traditional mixed doubles social！
(Feels like a college club... No wonder our team's weak...)
So those who decided on a pair, please write it on the bulletin board. All right, you're dismissed for today！
Everyone
Good work！
Doubles, huh？ What should I do...
Takane
You've got a partner already, right, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ You're our top player.
Huh!? Even as the top player？ Aren't you pairing with your partner from last time？
Last time, the girls had one extra, so I couldn't play... I'm always the one left over.
Maybe the guys are all too intimidated... Then how about pairing with me？
Don't force yourself... I'm used to it, so I'll be fine.
I'm not forcing myself...
It's okay. It's the same in class. I'm always the one left out. So really, it's okay.
Well, this is where I turn off.
Yeah, see you.
Um...
Hm？
Never mind... See you？ Goodbye.
Captain
Okay, everybody in！
Mixed doubles sign-ups close today. Anyone left？ Nobody, right？
Yes！ I haven't signed up yet！
What are you going to do？ Are you going to sign up？
Yes, I will enter with Takane-san.
Takane-san, are you okay with that？
Takane
Um, I... Yes...
All right, then you're dismissed for today！
Everyone
Good work！
▲Takane＊＊▲！！
Wait up. Let's walk home together？
Sorry for deciding that on my own.
But you really wanted to play in mixed doubles, right？
Of course you did. Anyone that good must've played since they were little, and besides...
Sometimes you clean the clubroom and courts alone at lunch... You love the tennis club, don't you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
(Did I upset her？)
Hey, if you really don't want to, I'll get the captain to cancel it.
That's not it... I'm... happy.
Thanks... I'm really looking forward to it...
Yeah. Same here. See you, then？
Yeah... see you later.
(Huh？ Isn't that ▲高嶺＊＊▲ over there...)
Takane
▲主人公＊▲.
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Stopping off on the way home？
No！ I just bought something at the bookstore. This isn't...
I was just joking, calm down... So, what did you buy？
A magazine called "Towano Watcher."
Oh, the leisure guide？ Going somewhere？
Sometimes I tutor the next door grade-schooler. As a reward for getting her grades up, I thought I'd take her somewhere.
Is that so...？ So, where are you going to go？
That's what the magazine's for... I think I should check the places out first.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ really is serious... Hm？ Wait, could it be...)
This scouting trip... are you going alone？
...Yes, that's the plan.
Can I come too？
Why？
I was just thinking I'm free on Sunday. No good？
But then, to other people, it'd look like, um...
Like a date？
I know my way around leisure spots, you know？ Better than that magazine. No good？
Really？
Yeah.
Then... please.
All right. Then I'll see you Sunday？
Yeah... Sunday.
(That was a little pushy... I'd better actually look up some spots.)
Well, we've arrived！
Takane
Yes. I'm glad the weather's nice.
What do you want to see first？
I want to see the rabbits！
Eh？ Even though we came all the way to the zoo？
Well... Yumi-chan, the girl that I'm planning to bring here, said she liked rabbits.
Is that so...？ Then rabbits it is！
First time I've ever spent that long looking at rabbits...
But they were really cute, right？
Well, yeah. That was fun, huh？
Yeah. I feel a little guilty, though.
Why？
Today was supposed to be scouting for Yumi-chan. Shame on me, huh？
Isn't that fine？ Now you know it's fun. You really are serious, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
...Hmm？
...I'm sorry.
...For what？
Even I think, "Wow, I'm out of step." Really.
Rules are rules. But I know living only by them is stifling.
I just can't balance that as well as everyone else...
So I'm sorry. I know being with me is stifling.
I don't feel stifled at all
You are a little uptight
That's what I like about ▲高嶺＊＊▲
I don't feel that way, though？
It's okay. I know.
So stubborn... I'm telling you, I don't feel that way！
You're overthinking it, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Nobody really has it all under control.
Being serious isn't a bad thing. That makes no sense.
But...
I think you're fine just the way you are.
▲主人公＊▲.
I just finally realized something.
If I'd been alone today, the walk home would've been really lonely.
That's why you came with me, isn't it？
Hmm, was it？
...You're kind.
We all need a hand sometimes, right？
Yeah... Thank you.
See you, then？
Yeah... Um, let's do our best in doubles too, okay？
Yeah.
I have to practice hard...
Yeah. Well, it's getting late, so...
Um... if you'd like... No, never mind. See you？
(...？ I'd better practice hard too...)
We're here！ Man, it's hot... Let's get inside.
Takane
Hehe, okay.
What should we see first？
Me, goblin sharks！
Goblin...？ Not dolphins or something？
...It's strange, right？
Fine！ Goblin sharks it is！
Goblin sharks... They looked like monsters...
But they're really fascinating sharks, right？
Well, yeah. That was fun, huh？
Yeah. I feel a little guilty, though.
Why？
Today was supposed to be scouting for Yumi-chan. Shame on me, huh？

Hm？
...I'm sorry.

I think you're fine just the way you are.

Yeah... Thank you.

Yeah... Um, let's do our best in doubles too, okay？
Yeah.
I have to practice hard...
Yeah. Well, it's getting late, so...
Um... if you'd like... No, never mind. See you？
(...？ I'd better practice hard too...)
Okay, we're here！
Takane
The sky's so high, it feels great... The autumn leaves are pretty too...
Yeah. It's pretty, but all this walking's going to make me hungry.
Hehe... I made lunch. Have some, if you'd like？
Yes！ Feels kind of like a date, huh？
Yes, so let's walk a little apart from each other？
(That's not what I meant...)
You're a good cook, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Thanks for the meal.
Not at all. It was nothing special, hehe！
The leaves were pretty, and it was fun, huh？
Yeah. I feel a little guilty, though.
Why？
Today was supposed to be scouting for Yumi-chan. Shame on me, huh？
Isn't that fine？ Now you know it's fun. You really are serious, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Hmm？
...I'm sorry.

But...
I think you're fine just the way you are.

Hmm, was it？
...You're kind.
We all need a hand sometimes, right？
Yeah... Thank you.
See you, then？
Yeah... Um, let's do our best in doubles too, okay？
Yeah.
I have to practice hard...
Yeah. Well, it's getting late, so...
Um... if you'd like... No, never mind. See you？
(...？ I'd better practice hard too...)
Okay, let's hit the ice！
Takane
It's my first time skating...
Oh... we should've gone somewhere else...
It's fine. Yumi-chan said she wanted to go skating too, so this works.
Okay. Then hold on to my arm. I'll teach you.
But then it'd be just like...
Kind of like a date, sure. Come on？
I'll try to manage on my own.
(She really insists it's not a date...)
You okay？ You fell a lot.
I'm fine. But that's probably the most I've ever fallen in my life, hehe！
Well, yeah. That was fun, huh？
Yeah. I feel a little guilty, though.
Why？
Today was supposed to be scouting for Yumi-chan. Shame on me, huh？

Hmm？
...I'm sorry.

I have to practice hard...
Yeah. Well, it's getting late, so...
Um... if you'd like... No, never mind. See you？
(...？ I'd better practice hard too...)
(Mixed doubles day is finally here...)
▲高嶺＊＊▲... Let's go win this.
Takane
Yes！
女子部員
Game set！ Three games to two. Match won by the Tezuka pair！
I let you down...
That was close.
I don't think so... I muffed easy shots and double faulted...
We ran into the captain's pair in the second round. It couldn't be helped.
What's the captain ranked again？
Third.
And you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
...Um, first, I guess？
Hehe... I had so much fun. For the first time in a really long time.
Lately, winning hadn't made me happy.
It felt like it just made people dislike me... But not playing my best would be rude to my opponent...
(So that's what happened... Then I guess it's okay like this？)
Haa！ Today I went all out and lost... Oh.
Come on... Cheer up？ Okay？
Let's work hard and win next time, okay？ See you...
Yeah, see you later.
(Hm？ She'll pair up with me again？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s really nice...)
Tezuka
You're dismissed for today！
Everyone
Good work！
Takane
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Umm... I...
Were you waiting for me？
(She seems a bit nervous...)
Oh yeah, Yumi-chan, was it？ How'd it go？
Yeah... She was really happy.
I see. Good, good.
Next time she's asking a boy from the next class on a date, and she wants me to come along again.
As a date chaperone？
Yes. She's only in third grade, after all.
Third grade!? ...Not bad, Yumi-chan.
So, um... I was wondering if I could ask you again.
To scout somewhere again？
Well, there is that... I, um...
I've never been on a date, so I was wondering if you could teach me...
Um... am I being asked out on a date？
N-No, that's not it！ It's practice, for chaperoning a date...
Wait, so, in other words...
Don't think any further than that...
I-I see...
Then once I pick a place, I'll call you.
Okay, I'll be waiting. See you？
See you later！
(Sunday's practice for chaperoning a date！ ...She insists it's not a date.)
Takane
The sea breeze feels nice...
Nice here, right？ It's close, it's safe, and it's kind of date-ish？
Yeah. I think it's a wonderful spot for a first date...
I'm glad.
What do we do next？ Um, as a date.
Let's see... First, we walk！
Okay！ Hehe！
I'm a little tired.
Yeah, we walked a lot.
Well, that's what dates are like, right？
Hehe... Oh, teacher, a question！
Teacher？ Oh, me. Okay, yes, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Teacher, have you ever... been on, um, a date？
Me？ Well, I...
Actually, it's my first too
Well, a few
Obviously not！
So I'm not much help. Sorry.
No, that's not the case.
Besides... That makes me a bit happy.
Huh...
What is it？
Nothing, I was just thinking that you're really reliable.
I-I see...
So we're both first-timers, huh？
Yeah. Ah, but this isn't a date...
The sun's setting soon. Want to head toward the water？
Yes, teacher. Hehe！
It's strange... I've been to the sea so many times, but like this, it feels like somewhere new.
Like this？
Yeah... The two of us standing here, watching the sunset...
Then I guess I'm some help. Um, as practice for chaperoning.
...Hehe, yeah.
Phew, we're back. We walked a lot...
Yeah. Dates are better exercise than I thought, huh？
Yeah.
Thank you. I had a lot of fun.
Yeah, glad to hear it.
Um... ▲主人公＊▲.
You know... maybe today was a date after all, I was thinking.
See you？
(I went on a date with ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
(Oh, it's ▲高嶺＊＊▲！)
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Want to walk home together？
Takane
...Okay.
Hey, did you hear？
What？
The club guys are doing another Winning Burger get-together.
...I see.
You should come too, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Okay？
It might be hard, but if you speak up, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, I bet everyone'll be happy.
I don't know what to say...
Let's see, how about an image change while we're at it...
Here goes？
"Hiya, it's Manaka♪ Wanna walk home together？"
"Tee-hee▼"
...No way.
No, no, it's creepy because I'm the one doing it. If ▲高嶺＊＊▲ does it, it'll be killer！
...Killer？
In a good way！ You can totally do it！
"Hiya, it's Manaka♪ Wanna walk home together？" ...Like that？
...Okay, that might be dangerous.
But you told me to！
No, no！ You can totally do it！
Member
Hey, you're coming, right？ To Winning Burger.
Yeah... Um, have you seen ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Takane？ No... She usually goes straight home, right？
(I see, she went home...)
(Huh？ Who's that over there...)
▲Takane＊＊▲！！
Takane
Ah, um...
I, um...
(Go for it, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
Hiya, it's Manaka♪ Wanna walk home together？
部員たち
Um, er... Tee-hee▼
(Yes, a huge success！)
You were really popular today, huh？
That's not...
Truth is, everyone just wanted to talk to ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Really？ You think so？
I do. I was a little jealous.
Kidding. See you？
Kidding... right. Yeah. ...See you？
(Sigh... The competition's going to heat up from here...)
(Oh, it's ▲高嶺＊＊▲！)
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. ...Were you waiting for me？
Takane
Yes... I wasn't a bother？
Not at all.
Good. Then shall we go？
Hey, let's try Winning Burger's new item on the way？
Sure... What about not stopping on the way？
We just have to eat promptly. Right？
Right. Okay, then... Hm？
Miyoshi
Ah, Takane！ Found you！
Girl Ｂ
Hey, hey, want to stop by Dixie's？
Um... But, I...
Huh？ Don't tell me... were you two alone together？
No way... Really？
No！ It's not like that...
But you look kind of good together...
Must be your imagination. See you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Okay. See you？
Then we're borrowing Takane, okay？
Sorry！ Bye-byeee！
２人
Hey, Takane, what's going on？ We'll get the whole story out of you, okay？
("Not like that," huh... Well, I guess that's the truth.)
(Oh, it's ▲高嶺＊＊▲！)
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Were you waiting for me？
Takane
Yes, just a little. ...Oh.
Boy Ａ
Hey, we're going for ramen！ Ramen！
Ah, sorry, today I kind of...
Boy Ｂ
Don't tell me you and Takane-chan...
Um, go ahead？ I just remembered something I have to do too.
Then it's settled！ Going off alone with Takane-chan is NOT allowed！
What the heck！ Hey, quit pulling me！
(Finally free... When it's just guys, the dirty talk always runs late...)
Hey！
It's Manaka♪ Wanna walk home together？
...Just kidding.
What are you doing here at this hour...
I wanted to walk home with you... I'm sorry.
You waited all this time？ ...Let's go. I'll walk you home.
(I'd heard the rumors, but... what a house...)
Sorry for making you walk me all this way.
I'm happy you waited, but don't push yourself too hard, okay？
Okay, I'll be careful.
Okay. ...See you？
You're kind... That's why I like you. Good night.
(Oh, it's ▲高嶺＊＊▲！)
Takane
Hiya, wanna walk home together？
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. You've got that down now, huh？
Hehe, yeah. ...Oh.
Girl Ａ
Ah, Takane！ Found you！
Girl Ｂ
Hey, hey, want to stop by Dixie's？
Um... But, I...
It's fine, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Go with them.
No.
...Sorry. We're about to walk home together.
No way... Takane, could it be...
It's okay！ Don't mind us at all？ Come on, let's go！
Girls A & B
No way, those two！ They'll hear you！
(I'd heard the rumors, but... what a house...)
The front's closed, so this way.
Sorry for making you walk me all this way.
It's fine... More importantly, was it okay to turn everyone down？
It's fine. I'm planning to tell everyone properly...
Tell them what？
That is... That I...
Manaka's Dad
Manaka, are you home？ Hurry up and come inside.
Yes！ I'm home！
Sorry, I have to go... Quietly, okay？
Y-Yeah... Not that I've done anything wrong, though？
My father has eighth dan, kendo and judo combined...
(Okay, I'll leave quietly...)
